video_title: Hornets at Celtics: Coach Charles Lee Postgame Media Availability | 10/14/2026

quotes.speaker: Charles Lee
quotes.summary_phrase: Charles Lee on limiting Boston's offensive rebounding
quotes.excerpt: This is one of the best offensive rebounding teams, they're really relentless.
quotes.quote: That's great effort. I think it's great attention to detail we talked about before the game. This is one of the best offensive rebounding teams, they're really relentless and I thought our guys had really good carryover from a point of the game plan that we talked about. I wish that we would not have given them the ball though 30 times on the flip side.
quotes.social_post: Charles Lee praised his team for their defensive effort against Boston but noted they still gave up too many offensive rebounds. He said the team had good carryover from the game plan but needs to tighten up those lapses.

quotes.speaker: Charles Lee
quotes.summary_phrase: Charles Lee on Brandon Miller's two-way impact
quotes.excerpt: When he steps on the court he has a great two-way mindset.
quotes.quote: Brandon's importance, yeah. I think that we get to see when he steps on the court he has a great two-way mindset. We feel his impact defensively and then offensively, he can score in a bunch of different ways. He playmakes in a bunch of ways. He's really vital to our pace. I think that when he's out and running, guys are looking for him, they trust him with the pass, and so I think that he really opens up a ton of things for us offensively and then again, love the impact he's given us defensively too.
quotes.social_post: Charles Lee on Brandon Miller: He has a great two-way mindset and is vital to the team's pace. When Miller is out and running, teammates trust him and he really opens up a ton of things for the offense.

quotes.speaker: Charles Lee
quotes.summary_phrase: Charles Lee on the need for consistent effort
quotes.excerpt: I would love to be able to bounce back with a more consistent effort for four quarters.
quotes.quote: I would love to be able to bounce back with a more consistent effort for four quarters. I thought that we had a couple really good stretches. I thought those middle two quarters were pretty good, but the first and the fourth, you know, just really weren't to our standards and I think our guys feel it. I don't want us to be a team that's trying to turn it on and off. I just want us to be always on, always trying to build winning habits.
quotes.social_post: Charles Lee wants the Hornets to stop turning their effort on and off. He says the team needs to be always on and focused on building winning habits for all four quarters instead of just the middle two.

quotes.speaker: Charles Lee
quotes.summary_phrase: Charles Lee on Dennis Smith Jr.'s leadership and impact
quotes.excerpt: He's really impacting the other team's ability to get into their offense.
quotes.quote: I expect number one, you see how defensively he's picking up guys full court. I think he's really impacting the other team's ability to get into their offense. Sometimes they're having to really get into their clock or they're running offense from a half court. And then I think offensively he does a great job of getting us set, putting us in the right positions, getting to the piece of the paint at times. You know, we can become a little bit of a jump-shooting team and I think he helps us break the paint and create some better looks. So I also will look to him off the court. I think that he has great relationships with our young players. I think that he's been in playoff situations, he's been in hostile environments, he's very comfortable and secure in who he is and he understands what's needed of you on every type of situation.
quotes.social_post: Charles Lee on Dennis Smith Jr: He is impacting the game by picking up players full court and helping the team break the paint. Lee also values his leadership and experience in hostile environments for the younger players.

quotes.speaker: Charles Lee
quotes.summary_phrase: Charles Lee on the continued development of Tidjane Salaün
quotes.excerpt: I just want to see continued growth.
quotes.quote: I just want to see continued growth. You know, for a young player, we try to do a good job of player development of really trying to minimize the things that he has to worry about focusing on. And so if he can really do a good job of focusing on the small things about his competitiveness, the details that it takes to really like screen at a better angle and running the floor, he's got such a good natural feel for the game, we're really excited about his future.
quotes.social_post: Charles Lee on Tidjane Salaun: The focus for the rookie is on small details like screen angles and running the floor. Lee says the team is really excited about his future given his natural feel for the game.

quotes.speaker: Charles Lee
quotes.summary_phrase: Charles Lee on the veteran presence of Christian Wood and Dennis Smith Jr.
quotes.excerpt: By having Christian, by having Dennis, by having all those guys in the locker room.
quotes.quote: It's very good for Tidjane. I think that by having Christian, by having Dennis, by having all those guys in the locker room, they're all going to support him and help him throughout his rookie journey.
quotes.social_post: Charles Lee believes the veteran presence of Christian Wood and Dennis Smith Jr is very important for Tidjane Salaun as he navigates his rookie journey.
